verdict.rationale: Lithic ships an official MCP server that lets AI assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) search docs, generate code, and execute live API requests in natural language, and the vendor explicitly frames this as agents acting 'using natural language' to manage card program policies. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the MCP server's natural-language command reliability beyond vendor blog and docs.
